verdict.rationale: Cal.com can find mutual availability across multiple people. It offers collective scheduling, slot queries by multiple usernames to see when two or more people are free, and connected calendars, and external AI agents can query those slots through the API or MCP server. However, nothing in the evidence shows AI ranking or optimizing the 'best' time, or continuously re-optimizing meetings after booking; it simply returns open slots for someone to choose. Missing for 10: native AI-driven time optimization beyond open-slot listing, continuous re-optimization or auto-rescheduling of booked meetings, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
